title: land keeps the worker's worktree when it stops before done, so a trailer fix needs no re-checkout
goal: a land run that stops at a step before done (stale, eval, lint, checks) leaves the worker's worktree and branch in place and names the fix for the step (for stale: amend the work commit's Self-Reviewed trailer in that worktree), instead of removing the worktree and asking for a re-checkout

run:
import sys
t=open('kb/_self/backlog.md').read()
sys.exit(0 if 'stops before done' in t and 'keeps the worker' in t else 1)
